name: Beastie
description: A masked creature with multicolored striped fur and balloons on its horn that befriends and protects a human.

timeline.summary: The reader meets a masked, striped, balloon-horned creature on a stream bank.
timeline.quote: There is a strange creature crouching on the bank, fur striped in many colors, a bunch of balloons tied to one horn.

timeline.summary: The reader befriends the masked beastie and lives in a pantry under its protection.
timeline.quote: your creature, your beastie, chases them away.
